blocks.text: We are also a Lennox Premier Dealer. Our technicians stay up to date on new AC technology, so we will have you covered whether you own a packaged system, mini-split, or evaporative cooler.

Residents of Alamo Heights can sign up for our air conditioner maintenance plan regardless of their cooling unit’s make or model. Even if you own a brand-new system, we recommend maintenance. All systems develop problems, which can compromise performance and energy efficiency. You might notice, for example, that your system is short-cycling or making strange noises. You might experience a combination of subpar performance and high utility bills.

Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is proud to present customers in Alamo Heights with Comfort Club Membership, which includes a spring AC tune-up. We are thorough with our tune-ups, taking anywhere from an hour to an hour-and-a-half to complete them.

Air conditioner maintenance covers all the basic tasks that Alamo Heights residents expect to be done. We will calibrate the thermostat, check refrigerant levels, clean the coils, replace the air filter, and so on. Our team will address any leaks, including air leaks and refrigerant leaks, tighten loose wiring, and lubricate motor bearings.

Before each tune-up, you will receive a postcard and email reminder so that you do not have to keep track of dates. Our team will explain each step of the process and write out a detailed report of our findings. Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is ready to set you up for AC tune-ups in Alamo Heights. Contact us today for more information.
